menu.style: brunch buffet with a sparkling toast
menu.service_notes: Buffet open 10:30-11:45. Hosted sparkling toast [PACKAGE] poured for the 11:45 remarks only; no full bar and no spirits. Coffee refresh every 20 minutes from 10:00. Cake is a display cake, sliced at 12:15, not a second plated dessert. Idris Pell is a fictional honoree in this sample, not a real person.
